item.title: Using uv for python package management
item.description: What is UV? An fast python package manager and project manager (Written in Rust) replaces pip, pyvenv, virtualenv etc. Runs scripts Installs and Manages Python versions Installation UV can be installed using any one of the package managers (homebrew, pacman etc) Commands Initializing a project uv init <project_name> The above command creates a folder named <project_name>. Inside the project name there is a complete project directory including the virtual environment. UV expects you to follow this project structure.
